name: cex
description: Centralised exchange: backend (api, engine, ws, db, mm) + frontend. Run everything with `npm run dev`.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend/api install && npm --prefix backend/engine install && npm --prefix backend/ws install && npm --prefix backend/db install && npm --prefix backend/mm install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend/engine run build && npm --prefix backend/ws run build && npm --prefix backend/db run build && npm --prefix backend/mm run build
scripts.services: concurrently -k -n engine,api,ws,db,cron,web,mm -c blue,green,magenta,yellow,gray,cyan,red "cross-env REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6380 WS_PORT=8090 WITH_SNAPSHOT=true npm --prefix backend/engine run start" "cross-env REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6380 WS_PORT=8090 npm --prefix backend/api run start" "cross-env REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6380 WS_PORT=8090 npm --prefix backend/ws run start" "cross-env REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6380 WS_PORT=8090 npm --prefix backend/db run start" "npm --prefix backend/db run cron" "cross-env VITE_WS_URL=ws://localhost:8090 npm --prefix frontend run dev" "wait-on tcp:8081 && npm --prefix backend/mm run start"
scripts.dev: npm run infra && npm run build:backend && npm run seed && npm run services
